# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant (less than one year old)  <sub>[v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c2 P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020), [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)</sub>; Jem  <sub>[v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an adorable, round baby with perfect dimples in his elbows and handsomely formed toes. He possesses bright, intelligent eyes and a cheerful smile.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c36 P35](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0035)_

## Personality

Little Jem is a happy and thriving baby who responds warmly to his family with smiles and vocalizations. He is deeply loved, cuddled, and doted upon by his parents and friends.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 c36 P35](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0035), [v4 c36 P37](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0037)_

## History

James Matthew Blythe was born to Anne and Gilbert Blythe in their little house of dreams at Four Winds. Named after Captain Jim and Matthew Cuthbert, he became the center of affection for his parents and their friends. He grew up surrounded by playful baby-talk, despite theoretical rules against it. As he reached the age to be shortened and transition into short dresses, his family prepared to move from their original cottage to a larger home at the Glen.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c36 P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), [v4 c36 P37](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0037), [v4 c40 P16](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0016), [v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)_
